scale.source: Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "bilion": "1. (di Britain) satu juta juta, ditulis sbg 1 000 000 000 000 atau 1012; 2. (di AS) satu ribu juta, ditulis sbg 1 000 000 000 atau 109"; CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "1000000000: << bilion[ >>];". CLDR gives "bilion" the value 10^9, the second sense, so the default scale is short. The long scale stays available for a call that asks for it.

group_mark.source: CLDR 48 common/main/ms.xml gives no own number symbols ("<group>↑↑↑</group>"), so it takes root.xml: "<group>,</group>".

decimal_mark.source: Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "perpuluhan": "titik (tanda) ~ titik (noktah) antara angka penuh dan angka perpuluhan (spt 7.5, 8.6)"; CLDR 48 common/main/root.xml: "<decimal>.</decimal>".

space_groups.source: CLDR 48 common/main/root.xml, which ms takes, groups digits with "<group>,</group>", so a space separates two numbers.

plural_scale_needs_count.source: Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "ribu": "empat ~ 4000; seribu 1. 1000"; "juta": "seribu ribu (1 000 000); berjuta, berjuta-juta beberapa juta": a scale word takes a count (seribu, empat ribu), and the bare word is the "ber-" form.

scale_noun_agrees.source: A Malay scale word keeps one form after every count. CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "2000000: << juta[ >>];", "1000000000: << bilion[ >>];".

joiner_tens_units.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "20: << puluh[ >>];": no joiner.

joiner_after_hundred.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "200: << ratus[ >>];": no joiner.

joiner_between_groups.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "2000: << ribu[ >>];": no joiner.

joiner_before_round_hundred.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "2000: << ribu[ >>];": no joiner after the thousands, so no group follows one.

small_multiplier_starts_group.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "1000: seribu[ >>];", "100: seratus[ >>];": 1100 is seribu seratus, so the hundred after the thousands is the next group and a hundred multiplier counts no group of thousands.

comma_between_classes.source: The CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms rules quoted for joiner_between_groups write no comma between two classes. No source opened shows a comma between two classes of one number, so a comma ends a number.

joiner_before_last_group.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "2000: << ribu[ >>];": no joiner before the last group.

joiner_before_half.source: Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "setengah": "1. separuh, seperdua: luasnya tanah itu ~ ekar": a half follows the whole number or the noun with no joiner. No source opened shows a joiner before a half.

ordinal_style.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-ordinal: "2: ke=%spellout-cardinal=;": "ke-" makes the whole cardinal after it an ordinal.

compound_words.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "10: sepuluh;", "11: sebelas;", "100: seratus[ >>];", "1000: seribu[ >>];": "se-", "ke-" and "per-" are part of the word ("seratus", "ketiga", "pertiga"), so a word splits into number words.

joiner.source: No source opened shows a joiner inside a Malay number. CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "20: << puluh[ >>];", "200: << ratus[ >>];", "2000: << ribu[ >>];" write none.

minus.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "-x: negatif >>;"; Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "minus": "2. tolak; tanda ~ tanda tolak".

minus_idioms.source: No source opened shows a Malay idiom that puts "minus" before a positive number.

article_one.source: Malay has no article that is also the number one; "se-" is part of a word (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "seratus": "satu ratus (100)").

of.source: Malay puts the noun after the number with no preposition: Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "ratus": "beberapa ratus: ~ rakyat mati".

fraction_of.source: Malay puts the noun after the fraction with no preposition: Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "setengah": "luasnya tanah itu ~ ekar".

denominator_particle.source: Malay has no particle after a denominator; "per-" is part of the word (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "sepertiga": "satu pertiga").

class_noun.source: No Malay class noun is read.

half_unit.source: No Malay unit takes a half before it.

lone_decimal_mark.source: CLDR 48 common/main/root.xml, which ms takes: "<decimal>.</decimal>", so ".5" is 0.5.

range_cue.source: Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua, "antara": "2 di tengah dua waktu (tempat, peristiwa dsb): Pekan Kuala Kangsar terletak di ~ Ipoh dgn Taiping".

entries.source: Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "kosong": "1. tidak berisi apa-apa: cawan ~; tin ~" and "3. sifar (bkn nombor): utk memanggil operator telefon, pusinglah nombor ~"; CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "0: kosong;". The first sense is no number, so the word is ambiguous. After "nombor" it has only its number sense.
Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "sifar": "(angka) kosong"; Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua, "sifar": "kosong; angka kosong; 0".

Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "lapan": "delapan; ~ belas sepuluh ditambah lapan (18)".
Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "seratus": "satu ratus (100)"; Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua, "seribu": "satu ribu; 1,000"; CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "10: sepuluh;", "11: sebelas;".
Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "puluh": "sembilan dicampur dgn satu (10); dua ~ dua kali sepuluh (20)".
Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "belas" II: "kata pelengkap utk menyebut bilangan antara 11 hingga 19; se~ sepuluh dan satu; dua ~ sepuluh dan dua".
Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "ratus": "bilangan sepuluh kali sepuluh; seratus satu ratus (100)".
Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "ribu": "bilangan sepuluh kali seratus; empat ~ 4000".
Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "juta": "seribu ribu (1 000 000)".

Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "bilion": "1. (di Britain) satu juta juta, ditulis sbg 1 000 000 000 000 atau 1012; 2. (di AS) satu ribu juta, ditulis sbg 1 000 000 000 atau 109": the second word of the -illion series, 10^9 in the short scale and 10^12 in the long scale.

Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "trilion": "nombor atau bilangan yg diikuti oleh 18 angka sifar dlm penggunaannya di Britain, Perancis dan Jerman dan diikuti oleh 12 angka sifar dlm penggunaannya di Amerika Syarikat dan Kanada": the third word of the -illion series.
CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-cardinal: "1000000000000: << trilion[ >>];", "1000000000000000: << kuadrilion[ >>];": the word after "trilion", the fourth of the -illion series.
Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "dozen": "(dozén) dua belas jumlahnya; berdozen = berdozen-dozen banyak dozen (jumlahnya)".
Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "setengah": "1. separuh, seperdua: luasnya tanah itu ~ ekar; bekerja ~ hari".
Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "separuh": "1. setengah, seperdua".
Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua, "per-": "dibahagikan dgn (digunakan utk menyebut angka pecahan): satu ~tiga satu dibahagikan dgn tiga": "per-" makes the whole number after it the denominator.

Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua, "beberapa": "jumlah yg tidak tentu banyaknya (lebih drpd dua tetapi tidak terlalu banyak)"; Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "juta": "berjuta, berjuta-juta beberapa juta". Before a scale word it takes the place of a count, and the scale word names no number.
Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "pertama": "1. (yg) kesatu: penuntut tahun ~ dan tahun kedua"; CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-ordinal: "1: pertama;".

Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, "ketiga": "= yg ~ (yg) nombor tiga"; "lapan": "kelapan yg nombor lapan (menurut urutan, giliran, dsb)"; CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) ms %spellout-ordinal: "2: ke=%spellout-cardinal=;". The same entry has "kelapan-lapan lapan-lapan sekali", a group sense, so the prefix is ambiguous.
